scene.background: Flat, muted sage green matte background with soft gradient
scene.arrangement: Centrally positioned on the bust, following the natural curve of the neck, layered with appropriate spacing

camera.lens_behavior: Shallow depth of field with soft fall-off; creamy background bokeh; sharp focus on the center-front metallic texture
camera.shooting_angle: Eye-level, varying between straight-on and a slight three-quarter perspective

lighting.setup: Large diffused softbox positioned at 45-degrees from camera-right; white bounce card at camera-left for soft fill; overhead silk for general diffusion
lighting.quality: Soft, wrap-around light with gentle shadow transitions; clean, bright highlights to define metallic edges and surface sheen

style: Minimalist editorial catalog, high-end lifestyle studio photography
quality_directives: Extreme detail on fabric weave and metal grain, no visible digital noise, professional color grading, realistic micro-reflections on metal surfaces, clean minimalist composition
negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3D render, CGI, plastic look, oversaturated, blurry product, watermark, text overlay, harsh shadows, specular highlights, cluttered background, lens flare, dust on lens, price tag, paper tag, product tag, hang tag, label, sticker, barcode
